name: com.tfhandywash/site
title: TF Handy Wash
description: Published laundromat facts, FAQ search and prefilled contact links. Sends nothing.

tools.name: get_machines
tools.description: Every washer and dryer size at TF Handy Wash as the site publishes them: the washer table (load size, capacity, price per wash cycle), the dryer table (price and minutes per cycle), what the site says about machine counts, and the FAQ answers on sizes, big items and the Speed Queen equipment. There is no live availability feed; the site points to the Speed Queen app for that.

language.description: Reply language: en (English, default) or es (Spanish).

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Every price TF Handy Wash publishes, quoted from its prices page: washer price per wash cycle by size, the dryer price and minutes per cycle, the cost-per-load table with the site's own home-load comparison, and the FAQ answers on wash cost, dryer cost and what to bring. Prices are returned exactly as published (strings such as "$2.75"); nothing is added up here.

language.description: Reply language: en (English, default) or es (Spanish).

tools.name: get_location_hours
tools.description: Where TF Handy Wash is and when it is open, as the site publishes it: the Find Us block (address, hours, phone, email), the directions link, the coordinates in the site's structured data, what the prices page says about being open 24 hours with nobody on site, and the FAQ answers on hours, holidays, location and parking.

language.description: Reply language: en (English, default) or es (Spanish).

tools.name: get_payment_methods
tools.description: Every way to pay at TF Handy Wash as the site lists it (quarters, the Speed Queen app, cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, cash through the change machines), the Speed Queen app block with the location code HANDYW and the store links, the site's change-machine and surcharge lines, and the FAQ answers on paying. Payment happens at the machine; this server takes none.

language.description: Reply language: en (English, default) or es (Spanish).

tools.name: get_amenities
tools.description: What is at the store besides the machines, as the site publishes it: the prices page list (cameras, lighting, Wi-Fi, seating, folding tables, restrooms, accessibility, parking, laundry-supply vending, bilingual signs) and the FAQ answers on Wi-Fi, tables and seating, supplies, restrooms, wheelchair access and safety at night.

language.description: Reply language: en (English, default) or es (Spanish).

tools.name: get_cycle_times
tools.description: How long washing and drying take and when the store is quietest, as the FAQ answers it. Two published answers give different drying times; both time estimates are returned with their source.

language.description: Reply language: en (English, default) or es (Spanish).

tools.name: how_to_report_machine_issue
tools.description: Read-only: returns the published way to report a washer, dryer or payment problem in English or Spanish: call or text, or email, what to include (machine number, what happened, when and how you paid) and what happens next. It files nothing, sends nothing and stores no report. It promises no refund (the site says it does not promise one on a web page). The store is unattended; a person answers the phone and email.

language.description: Reply language: en (English, default) or es (Spanish).

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Published TF Handy Wash FAQ questions and answers in English or Spanish, with their source URLs. A query searches words in the questions and answers; without a query the first answers are returned.

query.description: Nonblank words to find in the published FAQ.

tools.name: get_contact_form_link
tools.description: A link to the existing English or Spanish contact form with a supported topic, machine number and non-personal message prefilled. It sends nothing and has no name, email or phone inputs. Message text appears in the URL; the person adds contact details on the page, reviews the form and presses Send.

topic.description: A form topic. Feedback is supported by the English form only.

machine.description: Machine number or short equipment label, without personal details.

message.description: Non-personal problem details. Names and contact information belong on the form, not in the link.
